publicationSanitization.transform: Only task-specific absolute filesystem prefixes and the runtime executable path are replaced by stable role placeholders. Error text, observed status, SHA values, numbers and booleans are retained.
publicationSanitization.rawOutputHashMeaning: rawStdoutSHA256/rawStderrSHA256 bind original private stdout.txt/stderr.txt bytes before path replacement. They are NOT hashes of published sanitized text.
publicationSanitization.publishedOutputHashMeaning: publishedStdoutSHA256/publishedStderrSHA256 bind each embedded sanitized UTF-8 stdout/stderr string in this file.
publicationSanitization.collector: The adjacent collector is copied byte-for-byte and its SHA matches both original receipts. It is not path-rewritten.
